orchestration_smoke.note: Teammates reported TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList/TaskGet absent after ToolSearch and relayed handoffs by SendMessage; the lead persisted task state. This is an environmental/tool-surface finding, not a plugin crash.

env.source: live settings and scratch config; both included in the prepare manifest env_keys

orchestration_smoke.task_tool_evidence: ToolSearch for TaskCreate,TaskUpdate,TaskList,TaskGet returned No matching deferred tools found; no TodoWrite/TodoRead calls were observed in the subagent transcripts. Agent Teams was active (teammates spawned), so the missing task tools are not caused by an unset agent-teams env var.
orchestration_smoke.root_cause_hypothesis: Hypothesis, not isolated by a probe: claude Code 2.1.332 does not initialize the session team under claude -p; named spawns become ordinary background subagents, and TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList/TaskGet are reserved for true teammates. Agent Teams is enabled, but -p is not a valid teammate-creation environment (PACT README recovery branch C/D documents this).
orchestration_smoke.workaround: run_in_background:false foreground spawns receive the four Task tools; PACT documents this only as a legacy non-TTY compatibility note. Interactive PTY is the correct path for true Agent Teams.
orchestration_smoke.todo_tools: TodoWrite/TodoRead do not exist in Claude Code 2.1.332, so CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS does not explain the missing Task tools.

recommendations: Do not run Track B PACT-vs-solo in claude -p as if it were true PACT team mode: -p cannot form real teammates. Use an interactive pseudo-TTY for the PACT arm, or explicitly label a foreground/relay compatibility mode and do not claim Agent Teams parity.

For the native eval harness, keep the short-TMPDIR fix; do not use shell-dependent bootstrap/memory-save cases as baseline evidence until the eval sandbox permits reading/executing the plugin scripts and effect-based graders show a positive delta.
Prioritize pact-agent-teams and pact-handoff-harvest prompting/orchestration quality; pact-memory is the strongest selected skill but still has output-quality gaps.
Audit first-request spawn context: observed 52K-87K tokens per subagent (median 69K); reduce fixed teammate payload before adding more agents.
Run the Track B pilot/full matrix only after the team-mode decision and after the six task fixtures are committed.
limitations: Native eval bridge bug is fixed at the harness level, but native eval remains blocked for shell-dependent PACT cases by sandbox confinement.
PACT headless -p cannot form true teammates; Track B team-mode results require an interactive PTY or a labelled compatibility mode.
